rows.label: DELTA WAVE
rows.clue: The normal brainwave in the encephalogram of a person in deep dreamless sleep

rows.label: TRACTION
rows.clue: The friction between a body and the surface on which it moves (as between an automobile tire and the road)

rows.label: SULTRINESS
rows.clue: Oppressively hot and humid weather

rows.label: STRONG BREEZE
rows.clue: Wind moving 25-31 knots

rows.label: VIRTUAL IMAGE
rows.clue: A reflected optical image (as seen in a plane mirror)

rows.label: CAPACITANCE
rows.clue: An electrical phenomenon whereby an electric charge is stored

rows.label: BETA WAVE
rows.clue: The normal brainwave in the encephalogram of a person who is awake and alert

rows.label: BYPRODUCT
rows.clue: A secondary and sometimes unexpected consequence

rows.label: FLAKE
rows.clue: A crystal of snow

rows.label: SNOW MIST
rows.clue: Small crystals of ice

rows.label: DOUBLE BOND
rows.clue: A covalent bond in which two pairs of electrons are shared between two atoms

rows.label: WARM FRONT
rows.clue: The front of an advancing mass of warmer air

rows.label: RUBBING
rows.clue: The resistance encountered when one body is moved in contact with another

rows.label: MAGNETIC FORCE
rows.clue: Attraction for iron

rows.label: VOLCANISM
rows.clue: The phenomena associated with volcanic activity

rows.label: HEAD SEA
rows.clue: A sea in which the waves are running directly against the course of the ship

rows.label: POLARIZATION
rows.clue: The phenomenon in which waves of light or other radiation are restricted in direction of vibration

rows.label: PARTICLE BEAM
rows.clue: A collimated flow of particles (atoms or electrons or molecules)

rows.label: LIGHTNING
rows.clue: Abrupt electric discharge from cloud to cloud or from cloud to earth accompanied by the emission of light

rows.label: PROPULSION
rows.clue: A propelling force

rows.label: BINDING ENERGY
rows.clue: The energy required to separate particles from a molecule or atom or nucleus

rows.label: BREEZE
rows.clue: A slight wind (usually refreshing)

rows.label: LOW BEAM
rows.clue: The beam of a car's headlights that provides illumination for a short distance

rows.label: SOUTHEASTER
rows.clue: A strong wind from the southeast

rows.label: SERENDIPITY
rows.clue: Good luck in making unexpected and fortunate discoveries

rows.label: MONSOON
rows.clue: A seasonal wind in southern Asia

rows.label: ULTRASOUND
rows.clue: Very high frequency sound

rows.label: DRIZZLE
rows.clue: Very light rain

rows.label: COSMIC RAY
rows.clue: Highly penetrating ionizing radiation of extraterrestrial origin

rows.label: SOUND SPECTRUM
rows.clue: The distribution of energy as a function of frequency for a particular sound source

rows.label: FLOOD
rows.clue: The rising of a body of water and its overflowing onto normally dry land

rows.label: AFTEREFFECT
rows.clue: Any result that follows its cause after an interval

rows.label: FINE SPRAY
rows.clue: Precipitation in very small drops

rows.label: CROSSWIND
rows.clue: Wind blowing across the path of a ship or aircraft

rows.label: RADIATION
rows.clue: Energy that is radiated or transmitted in the form of rays or waves or particles

rows.label: COLD FRONT
rows.clue: The front of an advancing mass of colder air

rows.label: METEOR SHOWER
rows.clue: A transient shower of meteors when a meteor swarm enters the earth's atmosphere

rows.label: LEVITATION
rows.clue: The phenomenon of a person or thing rising into the air by apparently supernatural means

rows.label: OFFSHOOT
rows.clue: A natural consequence of development

rows.label: FOOD CYCLE
rows.clue: (ecology) a community of organisms where there are several interrelated food chains

rows.label: SOUTHWESTER
rows.clue: A strong wind from the southwest

rows.label: GALVANISM
rows.clue: Electricity produced by chemical action

rows.label: RELUCTANCE
rows.clue: (physics) opposition to magnetic flux (analogous to electric resistance)

rows.label: POTENTIAL DROP
rows.clue: The difference in electrical charge between two points in a circuit expressed in volts

rows.label: ELVES
rows.clue: An acronym for emissions of light and very low frequency perturbations due to electromagnetic pulse sources

rows.label: SOLAR POWER
rows.clue: Energy from the sun that is converted into thermal or electrical energy

rows.label: HOT WEATHER
rows.clue: A period of unusually high temperatures

rows.label: CHATTER MARK
rows.clue: Marks on a glaciated rock caused by the movement of a glacier

rows.label: COSMIC DUST
rows.clue: Clouds of particles or gases occurring throughout interstellar space

rows.label: ALPHA WAVE
rows.clue: The normal brainwave in the electroencephalogram of a person who is awake but relaxed

rows.label: TRADE WIND
rows.clue: Steady winds blowing from east to west above and below the equator

rows.label: TURBULENCE
rows.clue: Unstable flow of a liquid or gas

rows.label: GAS PRESSURE
rows.clue: The pressure exerted by a gas

rows.label: SCINTILLATION
rows.clue: (physics) a flash of light that is produced in a phosphor when it absorbs a photon or ionizing particle

rows.label: SUNSPOT
rows.clue: A cooler darker spot appearing periodically on the sun's photosphere

rows.label: WESTERLY
rows.clue: The winds from the west that occur in the temperate zones of the Earth

rows.label: SOUTH WIND
rows.clue: A wind from the south

rows.label: INFRARED LIGHT
rows.clue: Electromagnetic radiation with wavelengths longer than visible light but shorter than radio waves

rows.label: WHOLE GALE
rows.clue: Wind moving 55-63 knots

rows.label: FRESH BREEZE
rows.clue: Wind moving 19-24 knots

rows.label: ELECTRON BEAM
rows.clue: A group of nearly parallel lines of electromagnetic radiation

rows.label: MOON RAY
rows.clue: A ray of moonlight

rows.label: MOCK SUN
rows.clue: A bright spot on the parhelic circle

rows.label: RADIO WAVE
rows.clue: An electromagnetic wave with a wavelength between 0.5 cm to 30,000 m

rows.label: HEADWIND
rows.clue: Wind blowing opposite to the path of a ship or aircraft

rows.label: MISTRAL
rows.clue: A strong north wind that blows in France during the winter

rows.label: BALLISTICS
rows.clue: The trajectory of an object in free flight

rows.label: LINE SPECTRUM
rows.clue: A spectrum in which energy is concentrated at particular wavelengths

rows.label: MICROWAVE
rows.clue: A short electromagnetic wave (longer than infrared but shorter than radio waves)

rows.label: STRAIN
rows.clue: (physics) deformation of a physical body under the action of applied forces

rows.label: BACKWASH
rows.clue: The flow of air that is driven backwards by an aircraft propeller

rows.label: FIREBALL
rows.clue: An especially luminous meteor (sometimes exploding)

rows.label: BRAIN WAVE
rows.clue: (neurophysiology) rapid fluctuations of voltage between parts of the cerebral cortex that are detectable with an electroencephalograph

rows.label: GROUND EFFECT
rows.clue: Apparent increase in aerodynamic lift experienced by an aircraft flying close to the ground

rows.label: CRYSTALLIZING
rows.clue: The formation of crystals

rows.label: FLASH FLOOD
rows.clue: A sudden local flood of great volume and short duration

rows.label: MIRAGE
rows.clue: An optical illusion in which atmospheric refraction by a layer of hot air distorts or inverts reflections of distant objects

rows.label: LIFE FORCE
rows.clue: (biology) a hypothetical force (not physical or chemical) once thought by Henri Bergson to cause the evolution and development of organisms

rows.label: TORQUE
rows.clue: A twisting force

rows.label: STREAMER
rows.clue: Light that streams

rows.label: CURRENT
rows.clue: A flow of electricity through a conductor

rows.label: OPACITY
rows.clue: The phenomenon of not permitting the passage of electromagnetic radiation

rows.label: WEST WIND
rows.clue: Wind that blows from west to east

rows.label: DIFFRACTION
rows.clue: When light passes sharp edges or goes through narrow slits the rays are deflected and produce fringes of light and dark bands

rows.label: TURBULENT FLOW
rows.clue: Flow in which the velocity at any point varies erratically

rows.label: SOUND PRESSURE
rows.clue: The difference between the instantaneous pressure at a point in a sound field and the average pressure at that point

rows.label: ALPHA RAY
rows.clue: The radiation of alpha particles during radioactive decay

rows.label: LUMINESCENCE
rows.clue: Light not due to incandescence

rows.label: PRESSURE
rows.clue: The force applied to a unit area of surface

rows.label: GRAVITY
rows.clue: (physics) the force of attraction between all masses in the universe

rows.label: COLOR SPECTRUM
rows.clue: The distribution of colors produced when light is dispersed by a prism

rows.label: AIR HOLE
rows.clue: A local region of low pressure or descending air that causes a plane to lose height suddenly

rows.label: JET PROPULSION
rows.clue: Propulsion by means of the discharge of a jet of fluid toward the rear

rows.label: GASLIGHT
rows.clue: Light yielded by the combustion of illuminating gas

rows.label: ELECTRIC FIELD
rows.clue: A field of force surrounding a charged particle

rows.label: SOLAR HALO
rows.clue: A luminous halo parallel to the horizon at the altitude of the sun
